privacy.title: Privacy policy
paras: This policy explains what information Uptown Merch Solutions collects when you use uptownmerch145.com, why we collect it, and what we do with it.
WHAT WE COLLECT

When you place an order, we collect your name, email address, phone number, and payment information. Payment details are handled by Shopify and its payment processors — we never see or store your full card number.

When you contact us through the site or submit an enquiry for your organization, we collect the details you give us: your name, email address, phone number, organization name, and whatever you tell us about what you need.
When you subscribe to our emails, we collect your email address.

Like most websites, we also collect basic technical information automatically — your device and browser type, and how you move through the site. Shopify provides this to us in aggregate so we can understand what's working.
WHY WE COLLECT IT
To take and fulfil your order, to contact you when it's ready for pickup, to answer your questions, to prepare quotes for group orders, and to send you emails if you've asked for them.
HOW WE SHARE IT
We do not sell your personal information.

We share it only with the services that make the business run: Shopify, which hosts our store and processes payments; our payment processors; and email tools we use to reply to you or send updates you've subscribed to. For group and bulk orders, we may share order details with suppliers in order to produce your merchandise.
We may also disclose information where the law requires it.
HOW LONG WE KEEP IT
We keep order records for as long as we need them for business and tax purposes. You can ask us to delete other information at any time.
YOUR CHOICES

You can unsubscribe from our emails using the link in any email we send. You can ask us what personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Contact us and we'll take care of it.
COOKIES
Our site uses cookies to keep your cart working and to understand how the site is used. You can block cookies in your browser, though parts of the site may stop working properly if you do.
CHILDREN
Our site is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their information.
CHANGES
If we change this policy we'll update this page. Material changes will be noted here.
CONTACT
Questions about this policy, or about your information: email orders@uptownmerch145.com, call 646-398-8178, or write to Uptown Merch Solutions, 241 W 145th St, New York, NY.

terms.title: Terms of service
paras: These terms apply when you use uptownmerch145.com or buy from Uptown Merch Solutions. By placing an order you agree to them.
ORDERS AND PRICING

Prices are shown in US dollars and may change without notice. We do our best to keep product descriptions, prices, and stock levels accurate, but errors happen. If we find an error in the price or description of something you've ordered, we'll contact you before going ahead, and you can confirm or cancel.
We may refuse or cancel any order, including after it's been placed. If we cancel an order you've already paid for, you'll be refunded in full.
PICKUP
We do not ship. Every order is collected in person at 241 W 145th St, Harlem, New York, during opening hours — Tuesday to Saturday, 11am to 8pm.
We'll let you know when your order is ready. Please collect it promptly; we have limited space to hold finished orders.
ALL SALES ARE FINAL
We do not offer refunds or exchanges. See our Return and refund policy.
GROUP AND BULK ORDERS

Quotes for group and organization orders are prepared individually and are not binding until both sides confirm the order in writing. Quantities, pricing, and timing depend on what you need and what our suppliers can provide. Nothing on this website constitutes a price quote for a bulk order.
ARTWORK YOU SUPPLY

If you give us a logo, design, or other artwork to reproduce, you confirm that you own it or have permission to use it, and that reproducing it does not infringe anyone else's rights. You agree to cover us for any claim that arises from artwork you supplied.
We may decline to print anything we judge to be unlawful, infringing, or offensive.
OUR CONTENT
The Uptown Merch Solutions name, logo, product photography, and site content belong to us. Please don't reuse them without asking.
LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
To the fullest extent the law allows, our liability for any order is limited to what you paid for it. We are not liable for indirect or consequential losses.
GOVERNING LAW
These terms are governed by the laws of the State of New York.
CONTACT
Uptown Merch Solutions, 241 W 145th St, New York, NY. Phone 646-398-8178. Email orders@uptownmerch145.com.

shipping.title: Shipping policy
paras: Uptown Merch Solutions does not ship. We have no delivery or postal option, and no shipping is offered at checkout.
Every order is picked up in person at our shop:
Uptown Merch Solutions, 241 W 145th St, New York, NY. Tuesday to Saturday, 11am to 8pm.
We'll contact you when your order is ready to collect. Orders are usually ready within 24 hours, though larger or more involved jobs can take longer — we'll tell you if yours will.
Please bring your order confirmation with you.

Group and organization orders are arranged directly with our team, including how and when you'll receive them. If you need a bulk order delivered, tell us when you enquire and we'll discuss the options with you.
